title: Certificate Countdown
story: A cert expiry warning appeared in the monitoring channel. Which site is closest to expiring?
goal: Look at the expiry dates in /etc/ssl/certs.txt and report the domain that expires first.
hints: Dates written year-month-day sort correctly as plain text.

Run:
sort -k2 /etc/ssl/certs.txt | head -1
Then answer: auth.example.com
socratic: Which command shows you the evidence you need?
explain: In one sentence: what was the cause, and how did you fix it?
